title: Consent-first framework (dynamic/granular consent, pediatric assent + parental permission, withdrawal)
context: Ewing Registry Standards produces an OPEN, CONSENT-FIRST registry STANDARD (common data elements, governance, interoperability profiles) for Ewing Sarcoma. It is NOT a data store and Hee-Lee Oss never holds patient data. HIGH-tier task: the consent-first framework makes consent structural to conformance, covering granular/dynamic consent, pediatric assent + parental permission, and withdrawal. It is BLOCKED until an ethics-literate reviewer + patient advocate are secured (partner-004), and requires their sign-off. Binding guardrails apply: open/aggregate/de-identified only, NO real patient data anywhere (fixtures synthetic), per-source license verification (bind terminologies by reference, never redistribute), no medical advice, and provenance on every assertion. No partner or expert reviewers are secured yet, so verifiedNeed is false and requestor is TO BE SECURED.
objective: Define the consent-first framework as a structural conformance requirement covering granular/dynamic consent, pediatric assent + parental permission, and withdrawal.
acceptanceCriteria: Consent is structural (cannot conform without it)
Covers granular/dynamic consent, pediatric assent + parental permission, and withdrawal/revocation
